bloodmoon.message.blood.start: ☾ The Blood Moon rises... the dead are restless.

bloodmoon.message.super.start: ☾ The HARVEST MOON rises. May the gods protect you.
bloodmoon.message.super.end: The Harvest Moon retreats... for now.
bloodmoon.message.golden.start: ☾ The Providence Moon pours its golden light over the world.
bloodmoon.message.golden.end: The Providence Moon sinks below the horizon.

bloodmoon.message.executioner: ☾ A colossus descends from the rift dragging its maul... the ground cracks beneath it.
